name: drift-duel
description: Mobile-friendly 3D drift racing duel that runs in the browser
author: jeiel85

scripts.build:itch: vite build --outDir dist-itch && node scripts/app-index.mjs dist-itch
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:app && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
